translations.en.sahih: By the dawn
translations.en.pickthall: By the Dawn
translations.en.yusufali: By the break of Day
translations.id.indonesian: Demi fajar,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] ten nights
translations.en.pickthall: And ten nights,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Nights twice five;
translations.id.indonesian: dan malam yang sepuluh,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
translations.en.pickthall: And the Even and the Odd,
translations.en.yusufali: By the even and odd (contrasted);
translations.id.indonesian: dan yang genap dan yang ganjil,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it passes,
translations.en.pickthall: And the night when it departeth,
translations.en.yusufali: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan malam bila berlalu.

arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
transliteration: Hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr

translations.en.sahih: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
translations.en.pickthall: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
translations.en.yusufali: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
translations.id.indonesian: Pada yang demikian itu terdapat sumpah (yang dapat diterima) oleh orang-orang yang berakal.

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad

translations.en.sahih: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
translations.en.pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan bagaimana Tuhanmu berbuat terhadap kaum 'Aad?

translations.en.sahih: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
translations.en.pickthall: With many-columned Iram,
translations.en.yusufali: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) penduduk Iram yang mempunyai bangunan-bangunan yang tinggi,

arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad

translations.en.sahih: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
translations.en.pickthall: The like of which was not created in the lands;
translations.en.yusufali: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
translations.id.indonesian: yang belum pernah dibangun (suatu kota) seperti itu, di negeri-negeri lain,

transliteration: Wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad

translations.en.sahih: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
translations.en.pickthall: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
translations.en.yusufali: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
translations.id.indonesian: dan kaum Tsamud yang memotong batu-batu besar di lembah,

translations.en.sahih: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
translations.en.pickthall: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
translations.en.yusufali: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
translations.id.indonesian: dan kaum Fir'aun yang mempunyai pasak-pasak (tentara yang banyak),

translations.en.sahih: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
translations.en.pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
translations.en.yusufali: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
translations.id.indonesian: yang berbuat sewenang-wenang dalam negeri,

translations.en.sahih: And increased therein the corruption.
translations.en.pickthall: And multiplied iniquity therein?
translations.en.yusufali: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).
translations.id.indonesian: lalu mereka berbuat banyak kerusakan dalam negeri itu,

translations.en.sahih: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
translations.id.indonesian: karena itu Tuhanmu menimpakan kepada mereka cemeti azab,

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
translations.en.yusufali: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar mengawasi.

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
transliteration: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee akraman

translations.en.sahih: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
translations.en.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
translations.en.yusufali: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun manusia apabila Tuhannya mengujinya lalu dia dimuliakan-Nya dan diberi-Nya kesenangan, maka dia akan berkata: "Tuhanku telah memuliakanku".

arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
transliteration: Wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee ahaanan

translations.en.sahih: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
translations.en.pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
translations.en.yusufali: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun bila Tuhannya mengujinya lalu membatasi rezekinya maka dia berkata: "Tuhanku menghinakanku".

transliteration: Kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem

translations.en.sahih: No! But you do not honor the orphan
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak (demikian), sebenarnya kamu tidak memuliakan anak yatim,

translations.en.sahih: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
translations.en.pickthall: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu tidak saling mengajak memberi makan orang miskin,

translations.en.sahih: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
translations.en.pickthall: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
translations.en.yusufali: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu memakan harta pusaka dengan cara mencampur baurkan (yang halal dan yang bathil),

translations.en.sahih: And you love wealth with immense love.
translations.en.pickthall: And love wealth with abounding love.
translations.en.yusufali: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu mencintai harta benda dengan kecintaan yang berlebihan.

arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
transliteration: Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka

translations.en.sahih: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
translations.en.yusufali: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
translations.id.indonesian: Jangan (berbuat demikian). Apabila bumi digoncangkan berturut-turut,

transliteration: Wa jaaa'a Rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa

translations.en.sahih: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
translations.en.pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
translations.en.yusufali: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
translations.id.indonesian: dan datanglah Tuhanmu; sedang malaikat berbaris-baris.

arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
transliteration: Wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; Yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa

translations.en.sahih: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
translations.en.pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
translations.en.yusufali: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan pada hari itu diperlihatkan neraka Jahannam; dan pada hari itu ingatlah manusia, akan tetapi tidak berguna lagi mengingat itu baginya.

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
translations.en.pickthall: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
translations.en.yusufali: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dia mengatakan: "Alangkah baiknya kiranya aku dahulu mengerjakan (amal saleh) untuk hidupku ini".

transliteration: Fa Yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad

translations.en.sahih: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
translations.en.pickthall: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pada hari itu tiada seorangpun yang menyiksa seperti siksa-Nya.

transliteration: Wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad

translations.en.sahih: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
translations.en.pickthall: None bindeth as He then will bind.
translations.en.yusufali: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
translations.id.indonesian: dan tiada seorangpun yang mengikat seperti ikatan-Nya.

translations.en.sahih: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
translations.en.pickthall: But ah! thou soul at peace!
translations.en.yusufali: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
translations.id.indonesian: Hai jiwa yang tenang.

translations.en.sahih: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
translations.en.pickthall: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
translations.en.yusufali: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
translations.id.indonesian: Kembalilah kepada Tuhanmu dengan hati yang puas lagi diridhai-Nya.

translations.en.sahih: And enter among My [righteous] servants
translations.en.pickthall: Enter thou among My bondmen!
translations.en.yusufali: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka masuklah ke dalam jama'ah hamba-hamba-Ku,

translations.en.sahih: And enter My Paradise."
translations.en.pickthall: Enter thou My Garden!
translations.en.yusufali: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!
translations.id.indonesian: masuklah ke dalam surga-Ku.
